auth: Authorization: Bearer <BOXING_INTERNAL_TOKEN> (>= 32 chars) on every /internal route
guarantees: read-only: the Worker can reach only the store methods listed in read_methods
fighter and official ids in payloads are canonical (merged records resolve to the survivor)
derived values are labelled PropBetEdge-derived, carry metric versions and sample sizes, and are null unless status is available
matchup snapshots are immutable and never contain information from after their input_cutoff
fair prices appear only from a trained or validated registered model
market data: summarized, one bout per request, whitelisted fields; no tick history, raw payloads, provider ids, bulk lists or downloads (The Odds API prohibits raw redistribution)
site routes are fixed-field projections: no DOB, stated hometowns, identity evidence, reviewer names, provider ids or prices outside the one-bout market summary

market_data_rights.permitted: first-party summarized display and PropBetEdge-derived values, one bout per request
market_data_rights.prohibited: raw redistribution: bulk/list endpoints, tick history, raw payloads, downloadable files, passthrough of provider feeds

routes.summary: Canonical fighter: profile, identities, aliases, attribute claims.
Latest Fight DNA snapshot per metric key and version (canonical fighter).
Event with its card: bouts, participants, titles and officials.
Bout: event, corners (canonical ids), titles, current result, current scorecards, officials, weigh-ins.
Immutable point-in-time matchup snapshots (newest cutoff first) and any registered model outputs.

One bout: summarized current prices per book with freshness, best price, opening/current comparison, consensus/dispersion, and fair prices from trained models (empty while untrained). Never raw provider ticks or payloads.
Title and its derived reign history.
Division title map as of a date (holders, undisputed status, rankings).
Ranking entries of the snapshot in force on a date.
Official (canonical): profile, assignment counts, recent assignments.
Judge DNA and Referee DNA: descriptive, with sample sizes; small samples are null.
Model registry: versions, feature versions, training cutoffs, status (untrained models publish nothing).
Site home: upcoming and recent cards, latest results, scorecard watch, one Fight DNA feature, coverage.
Site event directory page (upcoming | results | all), optional commission filter.
Site event: summary, card in official sheet order, card-change counts, same-weekend cards.

params.ref: hex suffix of the event public id (12..32)

routes.summary: Site bout: corners with verified record entering and current Fight DNA, result revisions, scorecards, card, and the one-bout market summary when matched.

params.ref: hex suffix of the bout public id (12..32)

routes.summary: Site fighter directory page with verified records; optional name search.
Site fighter dossier: verified record, verified bouts, current Fight DNA (or a redirect for merged records).

params.ref: hex suffix of the fighter public id (12..32)

routes.summary: Site Title Map: divisions, sanctioning bodies with source review state, and the division title map when requested.
Site rankings: sanctioning bodies with source review state, stored snapshot index, and one snapshot when requested.
Site coverage counts: what is on verified record and what is still pending.
